stories.headline: Hawaii-Based American Savings Bank Files for IPO
stories.body: Hawaii-based community bank American Savings Bank has filed for a proposed initial public offering, the bank said in a Monday (Aug. 24) press release. American Savings Bank publicly filed a registration statement on Form S-1 with the Office of the Comptroller of the Currency (OCC), according to the release. stories.headline: A $111 million scheme to keep bad merchants banked
stories.body: Thomas Eide's CB Surety ran small charges on prepaid cards to dilute clients' charge-back ratios, keeping open the accounts banks would have closed.
